title: Config Center
description: Versioned configuration of namespace {{namespace}}: edit drafts, publish, compare and roll back
noNamespace: Select a namespace to manage its configuration.
selectItemDescription: Pick a key from the tree to edit its draft, publish it or browse its versions.

tree.label: Config items
tree.emptyDescription: Create an item to distribute settings to your nodes.

item.readOnlyHint: This item belongs to a system group maintained by Spinneret and cannot be edited from the console.
item.notFoundDescription: {{label}} does not exist in this namespace. It may have been deleted.
item.remoteChanged: This item was changed by someone else while you were editing. Saving overwrites their draft.

actions.noDraft: There is no draft to publish
actions.noOlderVersion: There is no older version to roll back to

draft.matchesPublished: The content equals the published version; the draft was cleared

editor.jsonEmpty: JSON content must not be empty
editor.yamlServerCheck: YAML syntax and schema are checked by the server when saving and publishing.

schema.hint: Optional JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). The server validates the content against it when saving and publishing. Leave empty for no schema.
schema.notSupported: JSON Schemas can only be attached to JSON and YAML items.

group.reserved: Groups starting with "_" are reserved for the system
group.pattern: 1–64 characters: letters, digits, "_", "." and "-", starting with a letter or digit

key.pattern: 1–128 characters: letters, digits, "_", ".", "/" and "-", starting with a letter or digit

schema.syntax: The schema is not valid JSON
schema.type: The schema must be a JSON object or a boolean
schema.size: The schema must be at most 1 MiB

secretRefs.title: Secret references
secretRefs.short: Reference secrets with ${secret:path} or ${secret:path#version}. The console shows references as written; nodes receive resolved values.
secretRefs.syntax: Write ${secret:signing/api_key} for the current version or ${secret:signing/api_key#3} for a fixed version. Paths are relative to this namespace.
secretRefs.resolution: The console never resolves references and always shows them verbatim. Nodes receive the content with the secret values filled in, provided their token may read those paths.

issues.unterminated: Unterminated or too long secret reference (missing "}")
issues.path: Invalid secret path: lowercase letters, digits, "_", ".", "/" and "-" without empty, "." or ".." segments
issues.version: The version must be a positive integer

create.title: New config item
create.description: Create a config item in namespace {{namespace}}.
create.publishHint: Otherwise the content is stored as a draft.
create.createdDraft: Config item created as a draft

publish.title: Publish {{label}}
publish.description: Publishing replaces version {{current}} with version {{next}}. Nodes watching this item receive it within seconds.
publish.firstDescription: Publishing creates version 1. Nodes watching this item receive it within seconds.
publish.savesDraftFirst: Your unsaved changes are saved as the draft before publishing.
publish.noChanges: The draft is identical to the published content.
publish.commentHint: Describe what changed; shown in the version history.

rollback.title: Roll back {{label}}
rollback.description: The content of the selected version is published again as version {{next}}; history stays linear.
rollback.pickHint: Select a version to preview the change.
rollback.success: Rolled back {{label}} to v{{version}} (published as v{{newVersion}})

delete.title: Delete {{label}}?
delete.description: The item and all of its versions are deleted permanently. Nodes reading it will get not found errors.

versions.emptyWithDraft: Publish the draft to create version 1.
versions.pickTwo: Pick two different versions to compare.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.description: You have unsaved edits to this config item. Leaving now discards them.
